ModifyTheNumberOfNodeReplicasInANodeGrou.replicas: Desired number of node replicas in the node group. Valid values are non-negative integers.
ModifyTheNumberOfNodeReplicasInANodeGrou.instanceIDs: Set of node IDs to be added or preferentially removed
ModifyTheNumberOfNodeReplicasInANodeGrou.deleteInstance: Whether to delete nodes removed during node group scale-in. Defaults to false. Takes precedence over the node group CleanPolicy for scaled-in nodes.
ModifyTheNumberOfNodeReplicasInANodeGrou.deleteOption: Specify delete options for the given nodes.
ModifyTheNumberOfNodeReplicasInANodeGrou.deleteOption.deleteResource: Whether to delete the associated resources when removing nodes
ModifyTheNumberOfNodeReplicasInANodeGrou.deleteOption.deleteCDSSnapshot: Whether to delete the CDS snapshots when removing nodes
